paragraphs.text: Wrenna is a country in North Aerona on the plane of Dominaria .
Wrenna is located northeast of the Hurloon Mountains , on the western shore of the Sea of Whales and north of the blighted land of Muronia . The capital of Wrenna, Jenges , is located on the coast.

At one time Wrenna was the home of the Knights of Jenges , but around the year 3500 AR, a terrible mage seized the throne of Wrenna and started corrupting the Order. After this event, the knight Torsten Von Ursus left the Order and the realm, and journeyed southwestward to Benfosa, where he eventually founded Benalia .

By 4074 AR, the Order of Wrenna was called the Black Knights of Jenges . Among these knights was Terrill , who joined Gull 's wizard-hunting army after King Haakon of the Badlands was defeated and subjugated by the Stone Brain .
Before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , Wrenna was described as succumbing to corruption's cold embrace.
